about: The economy orchestrator's dials (Docs/Design/46-economy-orchestrator.md). Every number is a placeholder for the balance pass. mode: on (its prices and margin applied: doc 46, Phase 3), shadow (plan and show, apply nothing), off. RATW_ORCHESTRATOR=off|shadow overrides the mode. It measures every day and decides once a week, the evening of the weekly reckoning: overShare, overShareAtCap, priceMove and marginMove are per decision.
